label: original-phase input of z/f (also c/e/3), context-gated
explanation: Fires mostly in the original (input) phase (89% of activation mass), peaking at t=1-3, when the input token is z or f (about 31-34% firing rate, 6-7x lift, together 49% of mass), and more weakly for c, e and 3 (2.4-3x lift). The set {z,f,c,e,3} in the original phase covers 74% of activation mass but has only 38% precision, so the token alone is not enough and preceding context gates it. The largest activations come on repeated or consecutive z (e.g. z z z, b z z), and having z as the previous token raises the rate (3.4x). It rarely fires at the delimiter or in the copy phase (rate about 1.5%), and is weak after t=6. Adding position or first-occurrence conditions did not improve F1.
